name: Idaho Livin
old_description: Washed graphic tees and fleece shorts for hot days on the water.
about:
Idaho Livin was founded in 2017 in Boise, Idaho. The company operates a retail storefront in the Clearwater Building downtown, open seven days a week. Ownership structure and founder names have not been publicly disclosed.

The brand designs and prints its own line of graphic tees, retro and trucker hats, fleece shorts, and women’s apparel, all marketed for Idaho summers. Production is handled in-house at the Boise location, allowing the company to ship stocked items the next business day. The operation serves over 17,000 customers since launch, though facility size and headcount are not published.

Idaho Livin sells directly to consumers through its store and website, catering to outdoor enthusiasts and tourists seeking Idaho-themed apparel. A “Custom Apparel” section suggests the company also provides decorated garments for groups or businesses, though specific B2B industries or client examples are not detailed.

The company emphasizes its local roots—“Designed & printed in Idaho”—and fast fulfillment from Boise as key differentiators. Free shipping on orders above $75 and a physical retail presence reinforce a community-focused model built around the state’s outdoor lifestyle.
